cohort: 3,742 childbirth cases (35% natural births and 65% cesarean sections) covered by health insurance at three specialized maternity hospitals in Tehran province in 1400 (2021-2022)
finding: The study found variations in childbirth billing costs compared to the approved global tariffs across different hospitals in Tehran province.
mod_finding: Hospital A's billing costs for both natural and cesarean childbirths exceeded the set tariffs, while the billing costs in the other two hospitals were below the approved tariffs.
